purpose: Phase-7C shared confidence framework registry (Part 1 - Section 2). Confidence represents TRUST in the computational estimate - NOT biological activity. Declares the normalized->categorical boundaries and the propagation penalties every immune module applies through the shared ImmuneConfidence utility. Confidence is never artificially inflated: it decreases with missing inputs, incomplete registries, unavailable dependencies, conflicting signals, and prediction uncertainty. Deterministic.

propagation.base_confidence_note: Starting confidence for a fully supported prediction-only estimate (this is a prediction-only layer, so base confidence is modest by design).
propagation.penalty_note: Each applicable penalty is SUBTRACTED from base confidence (bounded at floor); penalties never increase confidence.
propagation.ceiling_note: A prediction-only layer never reports full (1.0) confidence.

policy.no_inflation: No module may raise confidence above the ceiling or above what its available inputs + evidence justify.
policy.confidence_is_not_activity: A high biological value with poor input support yields a LOW-confidence estimate, not a high one.
policy.decreases_with_gaps: Confidence generally decreases when required inputs are missing, registries incomplete, upstream values unavailable, or multiple biological interpretations exist.
